contexts.text: They that be in the fortifications and caves shall die of the pestilence () = the damnation of the evil which fortifies itself by means of falsity.
This is especially the case when these loves have fortified themselves with falsity as with a wall.
Fortresses = truths, in so far as they defend goods.
In the Word, when evil is compared to a city, falsities are compared to the fortifications around the city.
They then began to fortify themselves by means of towers, ramparts, and walls.
To draw waters for the siege, and to strengthen the fortresses () = to fortify falsities by various means against truths. AE 540:8.

As these things are signified by a prophet, it is said to this one, I have given thee for a fortified city () by which is therefore signified the doctrine of truth protecting against falsities. AE 223:3.
The total vastation of the Church is described by, He hath destroyed the strong holds of the daughter of Judah ()... Her strongholds (fortresses) = truths from good.
Fortifications () = confirmations from the Word; caves = confirmations from scientifics.
Fenced cities () = false doctrinal things which they have confirmed.

By your strong holds () is signified doctrine from the Word protecting; and by its being laid waste, is signified that there is no perception of it, and therefore no truth; for the like doctrinal things from the Word without spiritual perception are not truths, because they are falsified by ideas concerning them which are not just.
By a lofty tower, and a fenced wall () are signified confirmed principles of falsity, thus also those who are in them.
The dogmas protecting (falsities and evils) are signified by palaces, and by fortresses ().
By the fortifications upon the station, and the fortresses of fortifications () are signifies the things which are of Own intelligence confirmed by the sense of the letter of the Word...
He hath destroyed thy strong holds () = the taking away of protection. A strong hold = protection against falsities and evils; and the literal sense of the Word is this protection.
By the sea, and by the strong hold of the sea () is meant the Natural, where are these Knowledges.
By the cities of thy fortresses in which thou trustest () are signified doctrinal things from Own intelligence.
